new_learnings: The best opportunities today are in chemical and power-related groups, but many leaders are already too extended, so MA-distance discipline matters more than narrative.
Weak breadth with strong sector winners means stock selection should stay concentrated in leadership groups and sizing should stay smaller under very low IV Rank.
Several acceptable RPS names become automatic skips once MA-distance limits are applied; this rule meaningfully improves entry quality.
